# Natsume Soseki, "Nowaki" (Aozora Bunko)

Natsume Soseki's novel "Nowaki" (1907), in the public domain, from Aozora Bunko
(<https://www.aozora.gr.jp/cards/000148/card791.html>, the XHTML file `791_14959.html`, revised 2015-04-18).
The long-context set of `tools/quant_quality.py`, whose token ids are `data/quant_quality/long/set.ids.json`.

`nowaki-1.txt` holds chapters 1 to 6, `nowaki-2.txt` chapters 7 to 9, `nowaki-3.txt` chapters 10 to 12 (30,327, 14,912
and 15,890 tokens with Qwen3.8-Flash-Next's tokenizer). The text is the file's main text with the ruby readings dropped
(the base text kept), each character the file draws as an image (JIS X 0213) written as that character, the one
annotation `※［＃感嘆符三つ、320-13］` written as `！！！`, and the chapter headings on lines of their own. The
bibliographic notes below are the Aozora Bunko file's own.

```text
底本：「夏目漱石全集3」ちくま文庫、筑摩書房
　　　1987（昭和62）年12月1日第1刷発行
底本の親本：「筑摩全集類聚版　夏目漱石全集　2」筑摩書房
　　　1972（昭和47）年1月
初出：「ホトトギス」
　　　1907（明治40）年1月
入力：柴田卓治
```
